ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white/mottled pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast mottling across both lobes. Left lobe features a prominent circular dark blob (coordinates approx mid-left). Right lobe contains a thick, high-contrast diagonal dark band near the distal end. Central peduncle area is predominantly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:1.5 within the central bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, high-frequency micro-serrations along the majority of the boundary; one distinct irregular indentation located on the lower third of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered low-intensity circular pixel groups (approx. 5-8 count) located on the distal white region of the left lobe and scattered along the inner right lobe transition zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A primary, high-contrast diagonal linear mark on the right lobe; secondary horizontal parallel scratch marks visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep diagonal linear scar on the right lobe; prominent circular dark patch on the left lobe resembling a healed lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'eye-like' dark circular pigmentation pattern on the mid-region of the left lobe.
